text:
ops-bot: ALERT: p99 decode latency spike detected on runtime-us-west1 (service: runtime-pool). threshold breached: p99 > 1000ms. auto-page to #eng-oncall. link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/alerts/alert/12345

Mira: acked. I'm on it. seeing p95 ~ 880ms, p99 ~ 2250ms on streaming routes.

Sabrina: +1. any recent deploys/flags?

deploy-bot: Recent deploy: runtime-kernel v2.14.8-trt8-flashpatch pushed at 2026-03-14T08:37Z by @Devon. commit: a1b2c3d4. Rollout: 100% across us-west1 pools at 08:45Z.

Devon: I rolled a new TRT/FlashAttention kernel variant an hour ago to fix memory blowups. pushing rollback now.

Kai: what's the quick mitigation? can we flip a flag to avoid a full restart?

Devon: yes — we can disable the FlashAttention path in the runtime. ENV: ENABLE_FLASHATTN=false or set runtime flag --kernels=legacy. That should drop decode tail latencies quickly (no model change).

Mira: trying flag flip on a small canary first.

Kai: running redwoodctl patch to set env on 2 canary nodes:
```
redwoodctl exec -n runtime-us-west1 --selector canary=true -- bash -c '\n  export ENABLE_FLASHATTN=false && ./runtimectl reload-flags'
```

Mira: canary results after 2min: p95 140ms, p99 540ms on canary traffic. looks promising.

Tony: customer-impact note: three customers (acme-inc, edu-alpha, chatly) fired SLO alerts and some streaming sessions saw reconnects and 504s. CS has been notified; we should add a status page update if this persists.

Devon: starting rollback of kernel rollout to previous stable (v2.14.6) across us-west1. Command:
```
redwoodctl rollback --service runtime --to=2026-03-14T07:50Z --region us-west1 --strategy rolling
```

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated. target: runtime_kern_v2.14.6. Progress: 0/24 nodes patched.

Mira: capturing logs while rollback runs. excerpt from worker logs showing stall pattern: 
```
[2026-03-14T09:01:12Z] ERROR decode: tail stall detected, seq=0x7fae, latency=2089ms
stack: compilepath::prepare_kernel+0x1f3
kv_cache: eviction count spike=324
OOM? no, but page fault on JIT compile region
```

Sabrina: this looks like a compilepath regression (JIT kernel compile) not raw memory. matches compile flags change in recent kernel.

Devon: confirmed. new TRT8 kernel added aggressive compile optimizations (INLINE_KERNELS=1, JIT_COMPILE_ON_DEMAND=1) which seem to cause blocking compile on hot decode paths. rollback should remove those flags.

Kai: rollback progress: 8/24 nodes done, 37% traffic shifted. monitoring p99 across region; posting live graphs.

Mira: quick mitigation status: disabling flashattn on non-rollback nodes as stopgap. executed fleet command to set ENABLE_FLASHATTN=false across remaining nodes (graceful reload).

Devon: careful — disabling FA forces runtime to hit a slower path but it's stable. we should keep it until new kernel passes internal stress tests.

deploy-bot: Rollback progress: 18/24 nodes patched. ETA ~ 4m.

Mira: observed p95 now ~ 190ms, p99 ~ 620ms across region (from peak p99 2250ms). errors dropped from 0.8% -> 0.12%.

Tony: CS update: posted to status.redwood.ai: "Degraded performance for streaming inference in us-west1; mitigation in progress."

Sabrina: capturing all relevant artifacts for postmortem: deploy diff, compile flags, kernel build logs, stack traces, sample trace ids.

Devon: action items: (1) reproduce locally with same kernel flags, (2) add guard to compile pipeline to avoid blocking JIT on hot path (async compile), (3) add canary checks for compile latency on next rollouts. I'll own 1 & 2.

Kai: infra action: add automated pre-rollout test that simulates large-prefetch streaming workload and fails the rollout if compile p99 > 500ms. I'll own that.

Mira: handoff in 3h -> Sabrina will be primary follow-up. leave runbook updates and pager escalation thresholds in the incident ticket.

Sabrina: I'll take it from here at 12:00 UTC. creating incident ticket INC-2026-0314-08 and linking notes/graphs and the rollback diff.

deploy-bot: Rollback complete: 24/24 nodes patched to v2.14.6. traffic 100% shifted.

Mira: Confirm final metrics: p95 130ms, p99 210ms, error rate ~0.03%. Will monitor for 30m then transit to postmortem.

Devon: follow-up: do not reintroduce INLINE_KERNELS=1 / JIT_COMPILE_ON_DEMAND until async compile landing and perf tests pass. I'll attach a repro PR and kernel patch in the ticket.

Sabrina: noted. assigning follow-ups: Devon (kernel patch + repro), Kai (pre-rollout test), Mira (postmortem writeup).

Mira: thanks team. handing off to Sabrina. :raised_hands:

Sabrina: taking over. I'll post the incident summary and next steps shortly. :memo:
